messages:
marco_cs: Hey team — customer AcmeCorp hitting a regression after their IdP changed group claims. Multiple users get a 403 when opening the project console. Need triage. :warning:

emma_sre: Do we have repro + a sample user? Any API errors or only UI? Need org+project ids too.

marco_cs: Repro from customer: 1) SSO via SAML, 2) redirect to console, 3) spinner then 'Permission denied'. Sample user: user@acme.com. Org: org_12345. Project: proj_987. Screenshot shows logged-in user but empty project list and a 403 page.

luis_idp: Ask them for the SAML assertion or id token claims. Usually group claim changes are why role mapping stops working.

marco_cs: They sent a redacted SAML attributes dump — relevant part below:

``
<Attribute Name=\"groups\">
  <AttributeValue>acme-all-users</AttributeValue>
  <!-- used to contain acme-project-editors and acme-project-viewers previously -->
</Attribute>
``

emma_sre: That explains it. Our org mapping expects explicit group names. If IdP now emits a single aggregated group the claim-to-role mapping won't match and users end up with no roles.

idp-bot: SCIM sync job scim-sync-2026-03-12-09:14 failed: HTTP 409 Duplicate group exists (group: acme-project-viewers). Retrying in 30s.

luis_idp: I see an authz audit for user@acme.com at 1798764800: 'role resolution: no matching group mapping -> assigned: none'. So login succeeded but role resolution returned empty.

emma_sre: Short-term: org admins can invite affected users directly to project membership (Console -> Projects -> proj_987 -> Members -> Invite by email). That bypasses SCIM. But for ~200 users that's painful.

marco_cs: Customer prefers we update mapping rather than manual invites.

olivia_eng_platform: I'll take this. Need full SCIM logs and IdP assertion sample + the org's claim->role map JSON. We'll validate mapping rules and SCIM conflict behavior.

marco_cs: Uploading SCIM snippet and claim sample per customer permission. Excerpt: 

SCIM payload excerpt ->
POST /scim/Groups
Body: {\"displayName\":\"acme-all-users\",\"members\":[...]} -> 409 Conflict: duplicate displayName \"acme-project-viewers\"

Role mapping config (org_12345):
{\"claim\":\"groups\",\"mappings\":[{\"claim_value\":\"acme-project-viewers\",\"assign\":[{\"project\":\"proj_987\",\"role\":\"viewer\"}]},{\"claim_value\":\"acme-project-editors\",\"assign\":[{\"project\":\"proj_987\",\"role\":\"editor\"}]}]}

olivia_eng_platform: Looks like IdP collapsed multiple groups into acme-all-users while our org mapping still expects acme-project-viewers/editors. Two things from platform: 1) add a temporary mapping acme-all-users -> proj_987:viewer (canary), 2) improve SCIM sync diagnostics to surface when incoming displayName would shadow an existing mapping instead of returning an opaque 409.

olivia_eng_platform: ETA ~30m to apply canary mapping. I'll post the audit id when done.

marco_cs: Customer asked why we returned 409 — are we creating groups unintentionally?

luis_idp: 409 means our SCIM client attempted to create a group with a displayName that already exists. Could be IdP dedup policy combined with our create vs update logic. We'll inspect the create/update sequence.

emma_sre: Once canary is live, ask customer to test with one user and capture any x-request-id from the UI on failures.

olivia_eng_platform: Canary mapping applied at 1798765400. Mapping added: acme-all-users -> proj_987:viewer. Audit note: ENG-PLAT-1123. Rolling to remaining org mappings after validation.

idp-bot: Action log: mapping-change applied by olivia_eng_platform at 1798765400. AuditID: ENG-PLAT-1123.

marco_cs: Notified customer to retry login.

acme-customer-rep: Re-tested — ✅ user can see the project now. Thanks. What's the plan for a permanent fix?

olivia_eng_platform: Permanent plan: (a) clearer SCIM conflict messages and retry strategy, (b) KB for IdP/SSO teams explaining aggregated group claim behaviors and our mapping expectations, (c) optional heuristic to map aggregated group names to known subgroups (needs product/design). I'll open tickets for product/docs.

marco_cs: I'll update the support ticket and link internal bug ENG-PLAT-1123. :white_check_mark:

emma_sre: Good catch. Recommend we create a short KB: 'SSO group changes -> lost project access (403)' with recovery steps (invite vs add mapping vs IdP rollback).

olivia_eng_platform: Agree. Drafting KB and will ping docs. Closing internal thread after docs ticket created.
